metadata.description: Claude plugins from Red Center Studio: free website checks, small business websites, website monitoring, questionnaire filling from approved answers, a read-only audit of no-code apps, and a no-code app and data migrator to Cloudflare.

plugins.name: website-checks
plugins.description: Free website checks as MCP tools, no key: GEO audit (AI search readiness), domain health, AI crawler access, single point of failure DNS scan, Bubble® error decoder.

plugins.name: webdesk-claude
plugins.description: Build, preview and publish a small business website from Claude, with a quote form and an enquiry inbox. Free plan; sign in with an email code.

plugins.name: site-watch
plugins.description: Website monitoring: domain and certificate expiry, DNS and email records, AI crawler access and uptime, with plain alerts and fixes. Free plan.

plugins.name: vaultsheet
plugins.description: Fill security questionnaires and tender spreadsheets from answers your team approved, copied word for word, with gaps flagged. Free plan.

plugins.name: webdesk
plugins.description: Build a complete one-page small business website from a short brief and get back a ZIP the business owns. Prepaid credits, from $29 USD per website.

plugins.name: nocode-migration-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a no-code app before porting it to code. Writes a neutral app spec and a plain-language report. Bubble is supported today.

plugins.name: nocode-migrator
plugins.description: Move a Bubble® app's data, files, and full UI and backend into your own Cloudflare account with checks at every step. Free audit, plan, 3-page preview, and 1,000-record trial; passes from $39 USD.
